_PORT_TODO_entityFramework: The EF6 entityFramework config section (LocalDbConnectionFactory, SqlProviderServices) is replaced by EF Core configuration in Program.cs — register DbContext with builder.Services.AddDbContext<CatalogDBContext>(options => options.UseSqlServer(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("CatalogDBContext"))). The EF6 HiLo generator (CatalogItemHiLoGenerator) should use EF Core built-in UseHiLo().
_PORT_TODO_sessionState: InProc session (sessionState mode=InProc) must be configured in Program.cs: builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache(); builder.Services.AddSession(); and app.UseSession().
_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: system.web sections (compilation, httpRuntime, httpModules, globalization) have no ASP.NET Core equivalent and are removed. Application Insights HTTP modules replaced by Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore SDK configured in Program.cs. Globalization (uiCulture/culture en-US) can be set via app.UseRequestLocalization() in Program.cs if needed.
_PORT_TODO_webConfigTransforms: Web.Debug.config and Web.Release.config (XDT transforms) are obsolete on ASP.NET Core. Web.Release.config only removed the debug attribute from compilation — no action needed. Use environment-specific appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Production.json if environment overrides are required.
